items.description: Unknown routes return HTTP 404 and a JSON error. After an unknown request the service must still answer /health.
npm start listens on process.env.PORT, default 3000. Exported application/server factory is kept separate from the executable startup file.
npm test runs real HTTP tests on an ephemeral loopback port checking health, unknown route and health again; close the server after testing; no mocks.
npm run build checks all source JavaScript syntax. Deliver package.json, source, tests and README with instructions and a source-to-requirement mapping. CommonJS .cjs files.

PlantUML structure: Startup entry creates/listens on PORT; Tests create/listen on loopback random port; Client hits Application for /health or unknown route. All three components realized by src/server.cjs, test/health.test.cjs and src/app.cjs respectively.
